fields.先修: 两站独立积分 LRT 与充分压缩；门限、虚警与检出；实际复数发射块
fields.问题: 接收端不知道当次目标散射与目标无关信道，怎样从实际复数观测比较两种假设，再在通信和每站功率约束下调整发射？
fields.交互机制: 从新输入重估通信矩、求实际功率分配并生成复数 x/y；逐格核对先验最大化、Schur 二次型、AP/SP 门限、计数与 CCP 子问题证书。
fields.证据类型: 固定 v2 原理论与仿真；独立 Python 参考、九文件 JavaScript/实际 Node Worker 与教学数值审查。源算法在明确缩小模型中运行；浏览器与整篇复现待验收。
fields.结论边界: 固定 arXiv:2305.12523v2 的缩小条件化 MAPRT 与 CCP：4 TX、2 RX、每站 2 天线、2 UE、10 符号，合成几何/协方差。实际重算观测、先验最大化、通信矩、局部 CCP 和有限样本门限；保留全部失败与 holdout 越界。不是原图、完整 cell-free 网络、全局最优或真实浏览器认证。
fields.下一研究问题: 拟合矩可行而独立 holdout 越界时，什么才算可靠通信约束？相同每站上限但不同实际用能时，代理 SINR 排序为什么不能代替条件 Pd 排序？

paperComparison.observationsAndUnknowns: 实际多站向量 y 的已知 G/X 与未知 α/h：H₀:y=Xh+n；H₁:y=Gα+Xh+n。接收端知道统计先验但不知道当次 RCS/目标无关通道；先分别最大化带先验联合密度，再校准 MAPRT。发射幅度 p_i=√ρ_i 是优化变量，不是每 AP 独立功率。

The existing `supplement-case-distributed-detection` record for [fixed arXiv:2305.12523v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.12523v2) now also maps to a [genuine reduced MAPRT/CCP lesson](../cellfree-maprt.html#question). The independent two-station marginalized-LRT prerequisite remains distinct. There are still 35 canonical primary papers and zero full-paper reproductions; current/next remain CRB. The historical row 35 is superseded by this bounded milestone and the matching JSON record, without erasing its earlier audit gap.

Fresh inputs recompute channel moments, source power-allocation CCP, actual complex x/y, prior-maximized joint densities, finite null calibration and disjoint null/alternative evaluation. The disclosed 4 TX/2 RX/M2/2 UE/10-symbol synthetic conditional model is not the original-size deployment or source Figures 3–7. Independent reference evidence covers 64 cells and 1,048,576 stored scores; all six accepted restarts, 66 accepted outer iterations and 71 subproblem attempts retain five failed status-8 attempts and five bounded retries. The nine-file JavaScript implementation uses a separately reviewed barrier-Newton subsolver, not a claim to reproduce SLSQP histories. Its independent review retains 107/120 accepted restarts, 13 iteration-cap failures and 57/76 accepted allocations with a fitted-holdout crossing.

Same-y AP/SP comparisons, cross-allocation shared latent draws, separate calibration/evaluation and pointwise versus calibration-order uncertainty keep their different meanings. A numerical convex-subproblem certificate is not global nonconvex optimality, fitted feasibility is not population feasibility, and raw detector replay is not optimizer authentication.
